mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, increasing present value of future earnings and producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in declining FEDFUNDS periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, it triggers monetary tightening that increases cost of capital and reduces equity valuation multiples, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or the signal fails to show negative returns in at least 70% of triggered periods.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in real GDP growth (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate robust consumer demand that accelerates corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising GDPC1 and HOUST fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 40% of triggered instances, or the correlation between the joint signal and returns drops below 0.15.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 5.0%), labor market weakness suppresses consumer spending and corporate profit margins, generating negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of periods when UNRATE > 5.0%, or the average return in these periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate output and earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in declining INDPRO periods are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI growth falls below 2.0% (CPIAUCSL < 2.0% YoY), it indicates disinflation that enables central bank rate cuts, boosting equity valuations and producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL < 2.0% YoY, or the signal fails to show positive returns in at least 70% of triggered periods.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent increases in retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) reflect strong consumer spending momentum that accelerates corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising RSAFS and HOUST fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 40% of triggered instances, or the correlation between the joint signal and returns drops below 0.15.

mechanism_narrative: In low unemployment regimes (UNRATE < 4.5%), tight labor markets support wage growth and consumer spending, fueling corporate profit expansion and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of periods when UNRATE < 4.5%, or the average return in these periods is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).
